lines: I used to bring the copper down off this road. Now there is a Foundation cart on it every week.
Loaded coming down and loaded going up. Whatever is in it going up, it is not copper.
This is as far as a cart goes. Past the shelf the road is loose clinker and it eats wheels.
Everything out of Emberfall comes down on somebody's back. It always has.
There is a mast at Site 2 that points straight at the ground, and one at Site 4 that points at the mountain.
I asked a surveyor what they were listening for. She said she had not been told either.
Fourteen mile of that, twice a month. You stop noticing the smell around year three.
Do not walk the Coil after dark. The light off it will have you going in circles.
They lifted something out of Trench 2-7 up on the middle shelf in the spring. Crated it that night.
It was not a rock. I helped carry it, and I know what a rock weighs.
Nine trenches and I have cut six of them. Good pay, hot work, nobody bothers you.
What are we looking for? Nobody says. You get a bearing and you dig where they mark it.
